title: crotalaria cuneifolia
intro: Crotalaria cuneifolia, commonly known as Wedge-leaf rattlebox, is a species of flowering plant in the pea family, Fabaceae. It has been used in traditional medicine to treat various health conditions, including fever, cough, and respiratory issues, due to its health benefits of reducing inflammation and promoting expectoration. The plant exhibits therapeutic actions such as antimicrobial, anti-inflammatory, and antioxidant properties, which are attributed to its bioactive constituents like flavonoids, alkaloids, and saponins. The therapeutic actions of Crotalaria cuneifolia make it a valuable resource for developing new treatments for various diseases, and further research is needed to fully understand its potential uses.
